scripts.dev:infra: concurrently "npm run start:backend > .backend.log 2>&1" "cd frontend && npm run dev-server > ../.frontend.log 2>&1"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run start:backend > .backend.log 2>&1" "cd frontend && npm run dev-server > ../.frontend.log 2>&1" "cd frontend && npm start > ../.word.log 2>&1"
scripts.register: cd frontend && npx office-addin-dev-settings register manifest.xml
scripts.unregister: cd frontend && npx office-addin-dev-settings unregister manifest.xml
